name: agent-runtime-proof
description: Read-only local runtime identity proof through stdio MCP

interface.shortDescription: Prove whether a local Agent runtime matches an approved artifact.
interface.longDescription: Inspect and verify local Agent or MCP runtime processes against explicit artifact expectations without uploading data or changing host configuration and process state.
interface.defaultPrompt: Verify a local Agent runtime against an explicit artifact expectation and report the Proof, reason codes, and limitations.
